title: 第19章 不买别玩第20章 人老实话不多
content_zh:
气冲冲的回到客厅，林陌阑蹙着秀眉抱怨：
“爷爷！我们以后不让那家伙进门了！庄主伯伯都过世了他还不知悔改，简直无药可救！”
林雁山原本紧锁的眉峰，此时舒展了几分，溺爱的望着孙女，道：
“确实无药可救，但至少子言的心，静了。”
“心静？我怎么没看出来，他还是那副鬼样子！”林陌阑噘嘴道。
“你在门口骂他的时候，他没动气，已经算难得了，如果是以前，你们俩少不得动手打一场。”林雁山道。
林陌阑想了想，赞同的点了点头。
她与云极从小玩到大，也从小打到大，以刚才的局面，本应该两人从互相谩骂讥讽逐渐升级到大打出手。
两人在书塾里打到鸡飞狗跳才是正常现象。
“心静又能怎样，他今天还不是去赌了，不知悔改的烂赌鬼！”林陌阑气呼呼的骂道。
林雁山没说什么，蘸着茶水在桌面上写了个‘静’字。
“爷爷的字更加稳健有力了。”林陌阑小小的拍了个马屁。
“只有静到极致，无畏无惧，方有涅盘之日啊。”林雁山自语般唏嘘道。
林陌阑听不太懂，只觉得爷爷说得太过隐晦，回到闺房后想了想，恍然大悟。
涅盘之前，必定是生死之间的状态，那几乎就是死人了，肯定静到极致。
“难道烂赌鬼还能涅盘？”
林陌阑想起刚才的交锋，恨恨的道：“鬼才信呢！”
越想越气，她拿出一张今天特意去庙里为儿时玩伴求来的转运符，扔在地上狠狠的踩了几脚。
觉得不解气，将转运符捡起来准备烧掉。
可是当转运符贴近烛火的时候，又犹豫不决，葱白的手儿就是伸不出去。

哎……
云子言，你什么时候才能长大啊……
轻叹中，女孩将脏兮兮的转运符放在桌上，想要擦掉上面的脚印，可怎么擦也擦不干净。
……
街边一处售卖小动物的摊位前，云极正在兴致勃勃的逗弄着一只小狗崽，将其一次次翻过来四爪朝天，看着小狗费力的挣扎着翻过去，乐此不疲。
后来摊主都看不过去了，道：
“十个铜钱一只，诚心要的话八个铜钱卖你，不买别玩。”
“我这人只喜欢玩，不喜欢买。”云极呵呵一笑，临走前还提了个建议：“下次上点小乌龟，肯定更受欢迎。”
摊主还真听进去了，寻思着小乌龟更便宜，能吸引来更多小孩子。
后来反应过来，乌龟翻过来更好玩是不是！
云极心情不错。
白得了两百灵石是其次，主要多了位筑基境的帮手。
一旦查出害死老庄主的幕后真凶，以林雁山的人品绝不会坐视不理。
“陌上夜阑，襟袖起凉飙。”
云极暗自好笑，自语道：“林陌阑，名字挺不错，脾气像条狗，怎么不叫袖飙呢，又秀又飙。”
途经一处卖泥人儿的摊位，云极停下脚步。
架子顶端有个小泥人捏得栩栩如生，是个小姑娘的造型，顶着丸子头，大大的眼睛憨态可掬。
“老板这个多少钱。”
云极指向小泥人，看起来憨憨的很像小姨子，打算买回去送给阮青璃。
当姐夫的出来一趟，总不好空手回去。

“不要钱！送给少庄主了！”
卖泥人的妇人满脸堆笑将泥人包好，说什么也不要钱。
content_en:
Angrily returning to the living room, Lin Molan frowned and complained:
"Grandpa! We won't let that guy in from now on! Even the owner's uncle has passed away and he still doesn't repent. He is hopeless!"
Lin Yanshan's originally frowning eyebrows relaxed a little now. He looked at his granddaughter dotingly and said:
"There is indeed no cure, but at least Ziyan's heart is at peace."
"Peace of mind? Why didn't I notice that he still looked like that ghost?" Lin Molan pouted.
"It's rare that he didn't get angry when you scolded him at the door. If it had been before, you two would have had a fight." Lin Yanshan said.
Lin Molan thought for a while and nodded in agreement.
She and Yunji had been playing and fighting since they were little. Based on the situation just now, the two of them should have gradually escalated from scolding and taunting each other to fighting.
It is normal for the two of them to have a fight in the school.
"So what if you are calm? He didn't go gambling today. He is a rotten gambler who has no repentance!" Lin Molan cursed angrily.
Lin Yanshan didn't say anything. He dipped his hands in tea and wrote the word "quiet" on the table.
"Grandpa's handwriting has become more stable and powerful." Lin Molan flattered him slightly.
"Only when you are extremely quiet and fearless can you achieve Nirvana." Lin Yanshan sighed as if he was talking to himself.
Lin Molan didn't quite understand what he was saying. He just felt that what his grandfather said was too obscure. After returning to the boudoir, he thought about it and suddenly realized it.
Before Nirvana, it must be in a state between life and death. It is almost like a dead person, and it must be extremely peaceful.
"Can a bad gambler still achieve nirvana?"
Lin Molan thought of the confrontation just now and said bitterly: "Only a ghost would believe it!"
The more she thought about it, the angrier she became. She took out a lucky charm that she had gone to the temple to ask for for her childhood friend, threw it on the ground and stepped on it hard.
Feeling uneasy, he picked up the luck charm and prepared to burn it.
But when the lucky charm came close to the candlelight, he hesitated again, and his green-white hand just couldn't reach out.
Hey...
Yun Ziyan, when will you grow up...
Sighing, the girl put the dirty luck charm on the table and tried to wipe away the footprints on it, but she couldn't wipe it clean.
…
In front of a stall selling small animals on the street, Yunji was playing with a puppy enthusiastically, turning it over again and again with its paws in the air, watching the puppy struggling to turn over with endless enjoyment.
Later, the stall owner couldn't stand it anymore and said:
"Ten copper coins each. If you really want it, I'll sell it to you for eight copper coins. If you don't buy it, don't play with it."
"I only like to play, not buy." Yunji chuckled, and made a suggestion before leaving: "Next time, I will order some little turtles, they will definitely be more popular."
The stall owner really listened, thinking that the little turtle was cheaper and could attract more children.
Later I realized that it’s more fun to flip the turtle over, right?
Yunji was in a good mood.
Getting two hundred spirit stones for free is second, and mainly getting a helper from the Foundation Establishment realm.
Once the real culprit behind the death of the old village owner is found out, Lin Yanshan's character will never sit idly by.
"It's late at night on the street, and there's a chill in my sleeves."
Yunji was secretly amused and said to himself: "Lin Molan, his name is quite good, his temper is like a dog, why not call him Xiu Biao? He is so handsome and Biao."
Passing by a stall selling clay figurines, Yunji stopped.
There is a lifelike little clay figurine on the top of the shelf, shaped like a little girl, with a round head and big, innocent eyes.
"How much does this cost, boss?"
Yunji pointed at the little clay figurine, which looked very naive like his sister-in-law. He planned to buy it back and give it to Ruan Qingli.
When a brother-in-law goes out for a trip, it's hard to go back empty-handed.
"No money! Give it to the young owner!"
The woman selling the clay figurine wrapped the clay figurine with a smile on her face and asked for no money.
